name: OpenSky Network REST API
license: free for research/non-commercial use; commercial use requires contacting OpenSky
notes: Anonymous calls are rate-limited (~400 credits/day); registering a free account raises limits. Coverage has gaps where few volunteer receivers exist.

name: ADS-B Exchange API v2
license: free tier for personal/non-commercial use; commercial use requires a paid plan
notes: Check current ToS before redistribution - licensing terms have changed over time and heavy/commercial use is not free.

name: Mobility Database (GTFS + GTFS-RT aggregator)
auth_type: none for browsing; key for API
license: each source feed sets its own license; most are open/public
notes: Best single index for discovering live train/transit feeds worldwide - use it to look up the GTFS-RT feed for any given agency rather than tracking agencies individually.

name: DB Timetables & Disruptions API
notes: Covers live timetables, real-time delays and disruptions for the German national rail network.

name: Darwin Real-Time Train Data
license: free open data licence with registration
notes: Live train running information delivered as a continuous push feed rather than polled REST.

name: SNCF Open Data API
license: open license (Etalab / SNCF open data terms)
notes: Real-time schedules and disruption data for French national and regional rail.

name: Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS)
update_frequency: most imagery available within ~3 hours of observation
notes: Serves imagery from MODIS, VIIRS and other NASA earth-observation instruments as standard map tiles.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Sentinel)
notes: Not live video, but frequent full-resolution optical and radar imagery revisits - the largest free open satellite imagery archive.

name: CelesTrak Orbital Elements
notes: Two-Line Element sets used to compute real-time satellite positions with any SGP4 propagator; the authoritative free source for orbital data.

name: N2YO Satellite Tracking API
license: free for personal use per API terms
notes: Free tier capped around 1000 transactions/hour; returns live look angles and positions for any tracked satellite by NORAD ID.

name: 511.org Open Data (Traffic Events / Toll / WZDx only - no camera API)
notes: CORRECTED after implementation attempt: 511.org's public Open Data API only documents Traffic Events, Toll Data, and WZDx endpoints - it does NOT expose a camera/CCTV endpoint despite the 511.org website showing camera images in its own UI. Use WSDOT (cam-002) for a confirmed working camera API instead.

name: WSDOT Traveler Information API
license: free with WSDOT terms of use
notes: Official state DOT traffic cameras and travel-time data for Washington highways.

name: National Highways WebTRIS / Traffic England cameras
auth_type: mixed - some endpoints open, some require key
notes: Official government road-network data; verify per-endpoint terms as WebTRIS (traffic counts) and camera imagery are served separately.

name: Cloudflare Radar API
notes: Aggregated, anonymized internet traffic, outage and attack-trend data derived from Cloudflare's network - no PII.

name: IODA (Internet Outage Detection and Analysis)
notes: Detects large-scale internet outages by correlating multiple signal sources (BGP, active probing, darknet traffic).

name: Ookla Open Data (Speedtest Intelligence)
license: free for any use with attribution (check current repo terms)
notes: Not real-time - useful as a historical/background baseline for fixed and mobile broadband speeds, not for live status.
